interpretation.study: historical same-source pressure replays; not independent village risk samples
interpretation.core_status: failed if either valid scale ignites; passed only when both scales are valid and do not ignite
interpretation.ordinary_denominator: intersection of unambiguous retained ordinary IDs across available evaluations, excluding every planned intervention; not all ordinary buildings
interpretation.partial_cohort: intersection may shrink as missing evaluations complete; cohort_finalized flags full coverage
interpretation.area: physical covered roof node area counted once even with multiple owners
interpretation.matched_area_scope: controls were matched by nominal polygon-area sum only; internal overlaps and retained shared roofs can change actual cleared area; same-fire same-scale cleared-area differences versus selected are reported
interpretation.map: physical xy node centers; polygons are outlines, not whole-building loss
interpretation.map_detail: geometry-only common window around source, its nearest core, and all planned interventions within 15 m of that core; no change to full-core statistics; overview retains all cores, interventions, and observed propagation
interpretation.cost: nominal and actual cleared areas are not economic costs; money and household costs remain unknown
